name: install-firmware
description: The web installer: pick a port, a release, a firmware, and a board from the gallery. No toolchain.

steps.title: Install it
steps.description: A browser, a USB cable, no toolchain

steps.caption: Open the installer in Chrome and plug the board in.
Pick the firmware for your chip.
Or pick your board from the pictures: it already knows the pin map.
Choose it, and the installer knows every pin on that board.
